graph.title: LEGO 7242-1 Street Sweeper
notes: Manual is picture-only; piece-to-step assignments and exact stud ports were inferred from the images and are approximate where pieces are similar (e.g. which yellow 2x4 plate sits in chassis vs roof, which 30237a clip brick holds shovel vs broom).
Minifigure (helmet, torso, legs) is not in the parts list and is omitted.
Both Street Sweeper Brushes (2498) were placed on the single axle b36; the manual shows only one brush clearly.
Wheel holder (6157), wheel (30027b) and tyre joins use null ports since the catalogue holder has no pin port.
Vacuum nozzle assembly (dish, loudhailer, hose, 1x3 bar) connections are interpreted from small pictures; hose top is placed on the cab brick b25.
The 3836 broom is attached to the second clip brick b26; the 44822 hinge tile is joined hinge-to-hinge with the 44570 roof plate.
